title: 16 October 2026 Stock Market Updates: Sensex, Nifty Open in Green as IT Shares Rally
imageAlt: Sensex and Nifty market update, October 16, 2026
summary: Sensex opened at 74,341.08, up 25.47 points, while Nifty opened at 23,065.10, gaining 67.75 points.
IT stocks led early gains, with Tech Mahindra rising 4.95%, alongside Infosys and TCS.
Reliance, Bajaj Finserv, L&T, Kotak Bank and Hindustan Unilever were among the early laggards.
Asian markets advanced, while investors watched inflation data and the possibility of another rate hike.
author: Raghwendra Shukla

detailContent.heading: Sensex and Nifty open higher
paragraphs: Indian benchmark indices Sensex and Nifty began the session in positive territory amid gains in IT shares and supportive global cues. The 30-share BSE Sensex rose 25.47 points, or 0.03%, to open at 74,341.08. The Nifty gained 67.75 points to open at 23,065.10.

In the previous trading session, the Sensex had closed at 74,315.61 and the Nifty 50 at 22,997.35. Broader-market performance was mixed: the BSE Midcap Select Index lost 14.06 points, while the BSE Smallcap Select Index gained 13.89 points, or 0.16%, to 8,889.83.

detailContent.heading: Top gainers and laggards
paragraphs: Tech Mahindra, Infosys, TCS, Bharti Airtel and Titan were among the Sensex gainers. Tech Mahindra led the group, rising 4.95% in early trade.

Reliance, Bajaj Finserv, L&T, Kotak Bank and Hindustan Unilever were among the early losers. Reliance fell 1.08%. Market breadth on the NSE was negative, with 1,583 stocks declining, 1,043 advancing and 86 unchanged.

detailContent.heading: Gift Nifty and institutional activity
paragraphs: Gift Nifty signalled a positive opening, rising 112.5 points to 23,100.50 from its previous close of 22,988.
On October 14, foreign institutional investors sold equities worth ₹5,285.37 crore, while domestic institutional investors bought equities worth ₹3,319.39 crore.

detailContent.heading: Inflation concerns and Asian markets
paragraphs: HDFC Securities' Devarsh Vakil said unexpectedly firm wholesale and consumer inflation readings had raised concerns that the central bank might consider another interest-rate increase at its upcoming policy meeting.

Asian shares rebounded after heavy selling in the previous session and gains in US stocks. Japan's Nikkei 225 rose 1,229.05 points, or 1.91%, to 65,655. Hong Kong's Hang Seng gained 0.96%, South Korea's Kospi advanced 4.03%, and Shanghai's SSE Composite rose 0.51% at the time reported.

title: Gold and Silver Recover as Crude Oil Rally Pauses; Check City-Wise Rates
imageAlt: Gold and silver price update, October 15, 2026
summary: Gold and silver futures recovered after crude oil's five-day rally paused, easing some pressure on precious metals.
MCX October gold was last reported at ₹1,47,560 per 10 grams, up ₹1,712 or 1.17%.
MCX December silver futures were last reported at ₹2,11,323, up ₹2,985 or 1.43%.
International spot gold rose 1.65% to USD 4,154.41 per ounce, while city retail rates varied.
author: Raghwendra Shukla

detailContent.heading: Gold futures recover on MCX
paragraphs: Precious-metal futures opened higher on Thursday, October 15, as crude oil's five-day rally paused. The MCX October gold contract opened at ₹1,47,482 per 10 grams, up ₹1,634 from its previous close of ₹1,45,848.

The contract touched an intraday high of ₹1,47,650 and a low of ₹1,47,109. It was last reported at ₹1,47,560, a gain of ₹1,712 or 1.17%. The article also reported February gold futures at ₹1,49,851 per 10 grams, up ₹1,603 or 1.08%, with turnover of 649 lots.

detailContent.heading: Silver futures also rise
paragraphs: MCX silver futures maturing on December 4, 2026, opened at ₹2,09,028, compared with the previous close of ₹2,08,338. The contract later reached an intraday high of ₹2,11,348 and a low of ₹2,08,259.
At the time reported, silver was trading at ₹2,11,323, up ₹2,985 or 1.43%.

detailContent.heading: International gold prices
paragraphs: In international trading, COMEX gold gained 1.58% to approximately USD 4,172.80 per troy ounce. Spot gold was reported at USD 4,154.41 per ounce at 1:51 p.m., up USD 67.48 or 1.65%.

Enrich Money CEO Ponmudi R said gold had recovered from the previous day's decline but remained below the ₹1,48,000–₹1,48,600 resistance zone. The commentary cited support around ₹1,45,300–₹1,46,000 and then near ₹1,44,000. These are the levels quoted in the source article, not investment advice.

detailContent.heading: City-wise rates reported
paragraphs: Delhi: 24-carat gold ₹1,47,590 per 10 grams; 22-carat gold ₹1,35,300 per 10 grams.
Mumbai: 24-carat gold ₹1,47,440 per 10 grams; 22-carat gold ₹1,35,150 per 10 grams.
Kolkata: 24-carat gold ₹1,47,440 per 10 grams; 22-carat gold ₹1,35,150 per 10 grams.
Chennai: 24-carat gold ₹1,47,440 per 10 grams; 22-carat gold ₹1,35,150 per 10 grams. Silver was reported at ₹2,30,000 per kg in Delhi, Mumbai and Kolkata, and ₹2,40,000 per kg in Chennai.

title: Jio IPO Could Be a Structural Inflection Point for Reliance Industries' Re-Rating: Analysts
summary: Fortune India reported that Jio Platforms' proposed ₹30,213-crore IPO could help investors value the business independently.
The issue is scheduled to open on October 21 and close on October 23, with a tentative listing on October 28.
Religare Broking said a separate valuation could improve transparency in Reliance Industries' sum-of-the-parts valuation.
The article cited a ₹1,696 target price for RIL from Religare Broking; analyst estimates and targets are not guaranteed outcomes.
author: Chitranjan Kumar

detailContent.heading: Why the IPO matters to Reliance Industries
paragraphs: Fortune India reported that the proposed Jio Platforms IPO could be more than a liquidity event. Religare Broking said a public listing could establish an independent market valuation for Jio, one of Reliance Industries Ltd's major growth assets.
Analysts said a separate valuation could make Reliance's sum-of-the-parts (SOTP) valuation more transparent and potentially reduce the holding-company discount sometimes applied to conglomerates.

detailContent.heading: Issue size and timeline
paragraphs: The reported IPO size is ₹30,213 crore and includes a fresh issue of 27 crore shares. The reported price band is ₹1,065–₹1,119 per share. The anchor book was scheduled to open on October 19, the public subscription window on October 21–23, and the tentative market debut on October 28, 2026.
According to the article, Reliance Industries holds a 66.43% stake in Jio Platforms. Meta Platforms holds 9.98%, and Google holds 7.73%.

detailContent.heading: Brokerage views and growth expectations
paragraphs: Religare Broking assigned a Buy rating to RIL with a target price of ₹1,696, compared with a reference price of ₹1,156 cited in the article. This is the brokerage's view, not a guaranteed price or a recommendation from this news card.

The article said Centrum expected Jio's revenue, EBITDA and profit after tax to grow at compound annual growth rates of 14%, 16% and 16%, respectively, from FY26 to FY29. It also cited an estimated Jio equity value of around ₹11.5 lakh crore, based on 12 times estimated FY28 EBITDA.

detailContent.heading: Debt repayment and business opportunities
paragraphs: The article reported that up to ₹27,500 crore of IPO proceeds would be used to prepay or repay borrowings of Reliance Jio Infocomm Ltd. Analysts said lower debt and interest costs could support cash flow and financial flexibility.

Potential growth drivers discussed in the article included tariff rationalisation, migration from 2G to 4G and 5G, increased data use, home broadband, enterprise cloud services and AI-led digital applications. These are analyst expectations and may not materialise.

title: Ukraine Fires More Than 1,000 Drones at Russia; Oil Sites in St Petersburg Ablaze
imageAlt: Oil terminal fire in St Petersburg following an air attack
summary: Associated Press reporting carried by NDTV said Ukraine launched more than 1,000 drones across Russia in a large aerial attack.
Local officials said fires broke out at the Petersburg Oil Terminal and the Ruchi oil depot in St Petersburg.
The report said one person was killed and five were wounded in the St Petersburg attack, while Russian officials reported intercepting 1,015 drones.
The story also described Russian attacks in Zaporizhzhia and renewed tensions over attacks on energy infrastructure.
author: Associated Press

detailContent.heading: Reported drone attack and fires
paragraphs: According to the supplied NDTV report credited to the Associated Press, Ukrainian attacks set an oil export terminal ablaze in St Petersburg on Sunday as Kyiv launched more than 1,000 drones across Russia.

St Petersburg Governor Alexander Beglov said one person was killed and five were wounded. The report said fires affected the Petersburg Oil Terminal and the Ruchi oil depot. Companies also confirmed that a logistics centre belonging to retailer Ozon and a data centre associated with technology company VK were targeted.

detailContent.heading: Russian account of interceptions
paragraphs: Russia's Ministry of Defense said it had destroyed 1,015 Ukrainian drones over 15 Russian regions, as well as Crimea and the Black Sea. This figure is attributed to the Russian ministry in the report.

detailContent.heading: Attacks in Ukraine and energy infrastructure
paragraphs: The report also described Russian attacks on the southern Ukrainian city of Zaporizhzhia. Local officials said a woman died and at least two people were wounded, including a six-year-old girl. Two apartment buildings, 18 cars and an educational institution were reported damaged.

Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said Russian attacks on energy, oil and gas infrastructure had continued after discussions of an energy ceasefire. The article said Ukraine had reported 76 attacks on these sectors in the week following US President Donald Trump's October 11 announcement.

detailContent.heading: Diplomatic context
paragraphs: The report described growing tensions between Kyiv and Washington over Ukrainian strikes on Russian oil infrastructure. It also noted uncertainty over possible further US sanctions on Russia.
Details in this story reflect claims attributed to officials and parties cited in the report; they should not be read as independently verified findings.

title: Kolkata Durga Puja Stampede: 19 Killed, Including Women and a Child
imageAlt: Image accompanying The Quint report on the Kolkata Durga Puja pandal stampede
summary: The Quint reported that 19 people died and 25 were injured in a stampede at the Chorbagan Durga Puja pandal in north Kolkata.
The incident reportedly occurred on the evening of October 17 during heavy rain as a crowd surged near an exit gate.
The report said police arrested organisers and others as authorities investigated the circumstances of the crowd crush.
It also reported an investigation led by a sitting High Court judge and state compensation for victims' families and injured people.
author: The Quint

detailContent.heading: What happened
paragraphs: The supplied The Quint report said at least 19 people died and 25 were injured in a stampede at the Chorbagan Durga Puja pandal in north Kolkata on the evening of October 17, 2026.

According to the report, heavy rain was falling when a large crowd surged near the exit gate, causing a crush. Most of those who died were reported to be women and children. The pandal was subsequently closed to visitors, and injured people were taken to hospitals.

detailContent.heading: Police investigation
paragraphs: The report cited Deccan Herald as saying Kolkata Police arrested seven people, including organisers, in connection with the incident. It also said authorities registered a suo motu case of culpable homicide not amounting to murder and questioned additional people.

detailContent.heading: Investigation and assistance announced
paragraphs: The Quint cited Hindustan Times in reporting that Chief Minister Suvendu Adhikari announced a Special Investigation Team headed by a sitting Calcutta High Court judge to investigate the stampede.

The report said the state announced ₹25 lakh compensation and a Group D government job for the family of each deceased person, and ₹5 lakh for each injured person, with medical expenses covered. These details are reported claims from the supplied source and should be checked against official updates for later developments.

title: Sheetal Devi Creates History With World Record-Equalling Show in Asian Para Games
imageAlt: Indian para-archer Sheetal Devi at the Asian Para Games
summary: Indian para-archer Sheetal Devi scored 704 out of 720 in the women's compound qualification round at the 2026 Asian Para Games.
Her score equalled the reported world record and surpassed the previous Asian record of 698 by six points.
Fellow Indian archer Payal Nag scored 675 and finished joint fifth in the qualification standings.
Devi, a 2023 Asian Para Games gold medallist and 2024 Paris Paralympics bronze medallist, will aim to carry her form into the knockout rounds.
author: Nikhil

detailContent.heading: Sheetal Devi equals the world record
paragraphs: Indian archer Sheetal Devi scored 704 out of a possible 720 in the women's compound archery qualification round at the 2026 Asian Para Games in Aichi-Nagoya, Japan, according to the supplied report.
The report says the score equalled the world record of 704 and exceeded the previous Asian record of 698 by six points.

detailContent.heading: Payal Nag adds to India's strong showing
paragraphs: Fellow Indian archer Payal Nag scored 675 points and finished joint fifth in the qualification standings. The report describes Nag, from Odisha, as a promising para-archer who won gold medals at the 2026 World Archery Para Series in Bangkok.
The qualification standings determine seeding for the elimination rounds, where both Indian archers will look to continue their performances.

detailContent.heading: A decorated para-archery career
paragraphs: The article notes that Sheetal Devi won gold in the women's compound solo event at the 2023 Asian Para Games in Hangzhou and earned bronze at the 2024 Paris Paralympics.
Her qualification score gives India an encouraging start in the women's compound event, although the medal contests are still to come.

title: Urban Company Shares Fall Over 7% as Losses Mount on InstaHelp Investments
summary: Urban Company shares fell more than 7.5% on October 19 after the company reported a wider loss for the September quarter.
The company posted a net loss of ₹182.48 crore, compared with ₹59.33 crore in the same quarter a year earlier.
Revenue rose 41% year-on-year to ₹537.29 crore, while the core business reported 28% revenue growth and an EBIT margin of 12.9%.
InstaHelp remained a major drag: its EBIT loss widened to ₹173 crore, and analysts were split between sell, buy and hold ratings.
author: Mangalam Maloo and Hormaz Fatakia

detailContent.heading: Shares decline after quarterly results
paragraphs: Urban Company Ltd. shares fell more than 7.5% on Monday, October 19, after the home-services company reported a wider loss for the September quarter. The supplied article described the stock as the biggest loser in the Nifty 500 at the time.
The company reported a net loss of ₹182.48 crore, compared with ₹59.33 crore in the same quarter last year. Its EBITDA loss widened to ₹187.6 crore from ₹68.36 crore.

detailContent.heading: Revenue grows despite larger losses
paragraphs: Revenue increased 41% year-on-year to ₹537.29 crore. The company's core business recorded 28% revenue growth, while earnings before interest and tax grew more than four-fold and the EBIT margin expanded to 12.9%, from 3.9% a year earlier.
Revenue for the Native business grew 40% year-on-year, and its EBIT loss narrowed slightly, according to the report.

detailContent.heading: InstaHelp weighs on performance
paragraphs: InstaHelp revenue rose to ₹20.5 crore from ₹1.4 crore, but its EBIT loss widened to ₹173 crore from ₹43 crore in the year-ago period.
The article compared InstaHelp with competitor Snabbit. It reported adjusted EBITDA losses of ₹174 crore for InstaHelp and ₹145 crore for Snabbit, with loss per order of ₹279 and ₹225 respectively.

detailContent.heading: Analyst ratings
paragraphs: Nine analysts covered Urban Company: four had sell ratings, three had buy ratings and two had hold ratings. Kotak Institutional Equities had recently downgraded the stock to sell and set a price target of ₹155.

The supplied article's final sentence says the shares were trading 7.5% higher at ₹146.3, which conflicts with its headline and earlier description of a fall. That figure is preserved as a source inconsistency and should be verified before displaying it as a live market fact.

title: Salman Agha's Century Helps Pakistan Beat Sri Lanka by 37 Runs in Tri-Series Opener
imageAlt: Pakistan's Salman Agha celebrates after scoring a century
summary: Salman Agha scored 107 from 90 balls as Pakistan made 305 in 49.5 overs against Sri Lanka in Rawalpindi.
Shaheen Shah Afridi took three wickets for 55 runs, helping restrict Sri Lanka to 268 in 48.1 overs.
Pavan Rathnayake scored 79 and Janith Liyanage made 60, but Sri Lanka lost their final five wickets for just 15 runs.
Pakistan will next face England on Tuesday in Rawalpindi in the tri-series, which is being used to build towards the 2027 50-over World Cup.
author: AFP

detailContent.heading: Agha anchors Pakistan's innings
paragraphs: Salman Agha marked his return to international cricket with a century, scoring 107 from 90 balls, including 10 fours and a six. Pakistan were dismissed for 305 in 49.5 overs in the tri-series opener in Rawalpindi.
Agha added 97 runs for the fifth wicket with Hasan Nawaz, who made 37, and another 64 for the sixth wicket with Arafat Minhas, who scored 18. Babar Azam contributed 45 and debutant Saad Baig made 39.

detailContent.heading: Afridi leads Pakistan's bowling
paragraphs: Pakistan captain Shaheen Shah Afridi took three wickets for 55 runs to help bowl Sri Lanka out for 268 in 48.1 overs. Naseem Shah, Haris Rauf and Faheem Ashraf took two wickets each.
Sri Lanka's Pavan Rathnayake scored 79 and Janith Liyanage made 60 during a 119-run fifth-wicket partnership. Kamindu Mendis added 44, but Sri Lanka lost their final five wickets for only 15 runs.

detailContent.heading: Agha returns to form
paragraphs: The report says Agha had endured a difficult period and had been sent home ahead of the third Test in England in August after captaining Pakistan in the first match. He also lost the Pakistan T20I captaincy.
Agha said he returned to domestic cricket to improve his performances. His century helped Pakistan begin the tri-series with a 37-run victory.

detailContent.heading: What's next
paragraphs: Pakistan are scheduled to play England in the second match on Tuesday, also in Rawalpindi. The tri-series is described in the supplied report as preparation for the 2027 50-over World Cup in southern Africa.
